message:
Could Rohin’s report of the raw child carrying unfinished work forward and checking what happened help you assess this latest copy?
What changes for the reader when the feather-touch passage omits your preceding version’s near-scream, and does that omission deserve closer attention?
Would further thought settle whether it serves your intention, or would a small writing attempt provide better evidence?
What thinking or doing step do you choose next?
What observation in the passage would make you change that choice?
What finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
